faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The details, made clear.
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before your order arrives.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Standard delivery takes 3–5 business days. Express delivery takes 1–2 business days.

items.question: Can I return an item?
items.answer: Yes. Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery when the item is unused and in its original packaging.

items.question: How do I care for my pieces?
items.answer: Care details are included on each product page. When in doubt, keep natural materials away from prolonged moisture and direct heat.

items.question: Will I receive an order confirmation?
items.answer: Yes. We send an email confirmation as soon as your order is placed, followed by tracking when it leaves us.

items.question: Can I change my delivery address?
items.answer: Contact us as soon as possible. We can update an address before the order has been handed to the carrier.

legal.detailsText: We want every part of shopping with Arden House to feel considered. If you have a question about a product, delivery, returns, or your account, our team is happy to help.
legal.contactText: Contact us with your order number and we will look into it as soon as possible during our support hours.
